note: Triennial election of the rural district council (nine divisions, two councillors each), polled 28 May 1914: contests in Cloghoge, Lower Creggan, Dorsey and Moybane. Lisleitrim is not filed: three were nominated (Peter John Bellew, James Caraher, Edward Sheridan) and there was no poll, but the withdrawal was not found. No party labels are printed. Polled 28 May 1914. Two seats; "First two elected." The nominations print "Michael James Blacker" and "Peter Loy".
